description: This PHP class 'WorkWeekDao' in the 'OrangeHRM\Leave\Dao' namespace provides data access methods for 'WorkWeek' entities, including saving a work week, retrieving a work week by ID, and checking if a specific date is a non-working day based on the work week configuration.

classes.name: WorkWeekDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for WorkWeek entity, providing persistence and retrieval functionalities.

methods.name: saveWorkWeek
methods.description: Persists a WorkWeek entity to the database and returns the same entity.

methods.name: getWorkWeekById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkWeek entity by its unique ID, or null if not found.

methods.name: isNonWorkingDay
methods.description: Determines if a given date is a non-working day based on the current WorkWeek configuration.
